name: switch-sched
description: Machine verification of the theorem layer behind indefinite causal order (Epoch 2): the quantum switch as an executable supermap certificate (isometry, dilation independence, fixed-order irreducibility for the involution/commutation task), the zero+zero→positive capacity theorem of switched channel pairs in exact arithmetic (Ebler-Salek-Chiribella flagship, replacer and completely depolarizing dilations), an admission table for 'order as a resource' on scheduling-shaped channel pairs (allocate/execute as CPTP maps, switch vs best fixed order), and a first toy of incentive constraints when report/allocation order is switched
